fields.ic_name: AMBA AXI / ACE Protocol Specification (ARM IHI 0022E)
fields.rationale: AXI/ACE does not define a JTAG/scan/BIST/MBIST/debug architecture. There is no dedicated debug interface for ACE. Debug visibility, if any, must be added by the integrator (typically via ARM CoreSight components) outside this spec.

spec_provided_observability.name: AxUSER / RUSER / WUSER / BUSER (inherited from AXI4)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Implementation-defined user signals to convey extra info per transaction or per beat. ACE does not redefine USER signals; per AXI recommendation, USER signals are discouraged for interop reasons.

spec_provided_observability.name: CRRESP[1] Error
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Cached master can signal an error during snoop response — observable by the interconnect / coherency monitor.

spec_provided_observability.name: RRESP[3:0] full encoding
spec_provided_observability.purpose: PassDirty and IsShared bits provide visibility into the coherency state of returned data; observable in trace.

spec_provided_observability.name: Default-slave DECERR injection
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Interconnect should route undecoded accesses to a default slave that returns DECERR; useful for catching out-of-map accesses.

spec_provided_observability.name: Coherency monitor (architectural)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Implementation-defined coherency monitor (point of serialization) records snoop traffic, RACK/WACK, and outstanding snoops for debug/trace.

ace_optional_features_via_properties: Snoop_Filter — interconnect may track shareability state to skip unnecessary snoops; requires correct AWDOMAIN for WriteBack/WriteClean/Evict.
WriteEvict — optional transaction (AWSNOOP=0b101) requiring AWUNIQUE signal; used when snoop filter must track UC->I eviction.
DVM support — DVMMessage/DVMComplete encodings on ARSNOOP (0b1110, 0b1111); optional per implementation but recommended for ARM v7/v8 cluster systems.
Snoop data bus width — optional narrowing (32/64/128/256/512/1024 bits, may differ from RDATA/WDATA width).
ACE-Lite — subset for non-cached masters (no AC/CR/CD).
fields.boundary_with_AXI5_E_features: AXI5 (AMBA 5) E-series features (cache stashing, deallocating transactions, atomic transactions, MPAM, tagging) are not part of IHI 0022E — they belong to the AXI5/ACE5 successor specifications.

evidence.quote: USER_REQ_WIDTH: 0 to 128 (AWUSER, ARUSER). USER_DATA_WIDTH: 0 to DATA_WIDTH/2 (WUSER, RUSER). USER_RESP_WIDTH: 0 to 16 (BUSER, RUSER).
CRRESP[1] Error bit indicates a snoop failure in the cached master.
RRESP[2] PassDirty and RRESP[3] IsShared bits provide coherency observability on the read data channel.
